Led end-to-end operational risk assessment and control testing programs as part of thesecond line of defence (2LOD), applying structured frameworks to evaluate internalcontrols, policies, and practices, ensuring continuous alignment with Group standards,regulatory requirements, and enterprise risk appetite across the organisation.

Coordinated and performed Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), maintained therisk register, and executed root cause and impact analyses for identified controldeficiencies; monitored action plans and conducted regular follow-up with businessowners, driving measurable improvement in control maturity and achieving sustainableissue closure across critical risk functions.

Identified, analysed, and reported operational losses and incidents through dedicatedgovernance tools, maintaining key risk indicator (KRI) reporting and preparing riskreports and management information for governance committees and boards, enablingfaster, data-driven decision-making by senior stakeholders.

Took ownership of developing, updating, and maintaining risk policies, functionalconcepts, and procedural instructions, including AML and financial crime regulatoryrequirements, ensuring alignment with Group rules and evolving regulatory standards.

Identified a gap in post-disposition follow-through on third-party findings andimplemented validation cycles to track corrective actions through to resolution,directly strengthening the control environment, reducing residual risk, and improvingoverall risk management maturity.

Managed enterprise-wide RCSA programs, scoping and assessing inherent and residualrisks across operational areas, mapping findings to key and non-key controls in the RiskControl Matrix, and maintaining consistent audit readiness.

Led walkthroughs to evaluate control design effectiveness, identify critical gaps, andestablish test objectives and documentation standards directing end-to-end design andoperational effectiveness testing using statistical sampling methods to identify controlweaknesses requiring remediation.

Partnered with business control owners to develop detailed remediation plans, defineaccountability, and monitor progress through governance dashboards presentingfindings and actionable insights in risk committee forums to support informed decision-making by senior management.

Reviewed and approved test documentation and workpapers ensuring adherence toglobal audit methodologies and internal quality standards maintaining high-qualitycontrol assurance delivery across all risk functions.

Identified a critical manual control vulnerability, built the case for automation, andcollaborated with the technical team to implement the solution delivering 2 FTEsavings, eliminating human error risk, and directly contributing to a stronger financialrisk control environment across the organisation.Risk and Controls professional with over 10 years of experience in banking and financial services,specialising in operational risk management, RCSA, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.Proven track record of identifying and reporting operational losses and incidents, drivingremediation cycles, and preparing risk reports and management information that support confident,data-driven governance decisions by senior stakeholders and committees. Eager to contribute astructured, process-driven approach to operational risk framework development within a dynamic,international banking environment.Risk Identification & AssessmentRisk Mitigation StrategiesRegulatory Compliance TestingControl Frameworks (COSO)Enterprise Risk ManagementControl Design & EffectivenessTesting (RCSA)SOX Compliance & ITGC TestingIT Risk Management &OperationalRisk incident Management.Data Analysis & ReportingMicrosoft OfficeEmailPhone+91 9551003131Barclays Shared Services Assistant Manager- Risk & Controls Management FEB 2018-JULY 2023LinkedInhttps://www.linkedin.com/in/priyadharsini-anandan-57347916b/?isSelfProfile=true

Managed middle office operations with a focus on position and cash reconciliationfor derivatives.

Identified and resolved discrepancies in daily reconciliations to ensure accuratefinancial records.

Coordinated settlements by working closely with front and back office teams toensure timely and accurate trade settlements.

Assisted in preparing reports related to reconciliations, settlements, and financialdata accuracy.

Supported end-of-day processes to maintain data integrity and ensure timelyresolution of issues.

Managed daily middle office operations for OTC derivatives, mutual funds, andother investment banking products, ensuring accurate trade capture, processing,and lifecycle management.

Performed detailed position, cash, and General Ledger (GL) reconciliations as partof the Record to Report (R2R) process, identifying and resolving discrepancies tomaintain financial accuracy.

Prepared and reviewed financial reports related to trade activity, positions, cashflows, and GL postings, supporting timely and compliant financial reporting.

Coordinated with front office, back office, and finance teams to ensure seamlesstrade settlements, break resolution, and effective operational controls throughoutthe R2R cycle.

Conducted quality assurance and governance checks on end-of-day (EOD)processes, validating reconciliations and ensuring completeness of financialreporting.
